jobs.description:
Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and close deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that’s transforming how some of the world’s largest industrial companies operate? That’s a different story.

 

Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and Arcelor Mittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments.

Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive France within the Sales Team,

you will have a front-row seat to the growth of an international SaaS scale-up and play a key role in expanding our presence in the French market.

  • Own the full sales cycle: You will be responsible for selling our SaaS solution and independently managing qualified sales opportunities from initial engagement through signed contract. This includes identifying and qualifying prospects, conducting discovery conversations, developing business cases, managing stakeholders, negotiating and closing deals.

  • Build our presence in France: Identify target accounts and create new business opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting and personalised outreach across relevant industries. Work closely with our BDR team to open conversations with new prospects and build awareness of Peripass in the French market.

  • Pipeline momentum and sales velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals.

  • Existing customer growth: Identify opportunities for cross-selling and selling to additional sites within existing customer accounts, in close collaboration with Customer Success and other relevant teams.

  • Deal negotiation and closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect's needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalising contracts.

  • Travel across France: the role involves travelling approximately two to three days per week within France to meet prospects and customers.

  • Work from our new French office: We are soon opening a new office in Paris.

  • Visit our Ghent HQ approximately every six weeks to connect with your colleagues. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first two weeks.

  • You will report directly to our GTM Lead, who is looking forward to coaching you extensively as you build the French market and grow your career at Peripass.


What we offer:

  • Front-row seat to scale-up growth: Be part of the next growth phase of Peripass in the French and have a direct impact on building our market presence.

  • Opportunity in a growing market: Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionising yard management in logistics, with the opportunity to make an impact in France.

  • Uncapped earning potential: A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn.

  • Ownership and freedom: Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best.

  • Backed by a strong team: From BDR and marketing to pre-sales and Customer Success, you'll have a strong team behind you, helping you create, close and grow opportunities.

  • A role with real impact: Help shape our French sales approach, market strategy and way of working as the team and market continue to grow.

  • Awesome office in the heart of Peripass with a dedicated team, combined with travel to clients and the option to work from home.


What you’ll bring:

  • At least five years of work experience, including two years of relevant experience owning a full sales cycle.

  • Experience working in a high-growth environment, preferably in SaaS or a similar context.

  • Experience managing complex decision-making units and closing deals of a comparable size.

  • Hunter mindset: You are not afraid of outbound sales or creating opportunities from scratch. Working in a scale-up means that you are willing to hunt, generate leads and actively open doors with new prospects. Of course, you will be supported by our BDR team, but mindset is key!

  • Strong stakeholder management skills for complex decision-making units and sales processes in international corporate environments.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.

jobs.title: Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)
jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The team

You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.

The opportunity

You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.

As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.

Your responsibilities

  • Build. Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.
  • Tune. Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.
  • Introduce. New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.
  • Test. You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.
  • Optimize. You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.
  • Shape. Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.
  • Accelerate. You use AI to generate layout variants, explore difficulty options and check solvability.

What we look for

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
  • Motivated. You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

Requirements

  • Experience. 1+ year in level design, game design or QA on mobile games, ideally puzzle games.
  • Languages. Fluent Turkish and English. You use both every day.
  • Volume with quality. You ship every week and never let quality slip.
  • Tool speed. You work fast in a level editor and pick up new tools quickly.
  • Data sense. You track level data and use it to tune your levels.
  • Puzzle instinct. You play puzzle games a lot and can explain why a level works.
  • AI native. You turn AI into output. You've built tools that generate layouts, check solvability or analyse level data.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Shipped levels on a live mobile puzzle game.
  • Experience with Unity or a similar game engine.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Our process (2 weeks max)

  • Call with our recruiter (30 min). A generalized conversation, and to tell you more about the role.
  • Level design case study. We look at your thinking and your technical skills.
  • Technical interview with the studio's level designers to dive deeper into technicalities.
  • Final interview with the studio founder and Homa's Puzzle lead. Focused on motivation, values, and fit.

Benefits

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Your scope and your rewards grow with what you deliver, not with tenure.
  • Real ownership. No layers between you and the result. You own outcomes, not tasks, whatever your level.
  • Direct impact. Your work moves the business and shapes where Homa goes next. Decisions are made fast, and you see the results in the numbers.
  • AI at the core. With access to the best AI tools, you'll help shape how an AI-first company works, and your time goes where your judgment matters most.
  • High talent bar. Our teams are small, with people from the best companies, and the talent around you will push you to grow.

What we offer

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

  • Comprehensive benefits. Depending on where you're based, you'll get perks such as health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym membership, and more.
  • A brand-new Paris HQ. A desk in our new office in the heart of Paris, whenever you want to work side by side with the team.
  • An international team. Work in English with top talent from 35+ countries across Europe, the UK, the US, and beyond. Our diversity fuels our creativity.
  • Team gatherings. We value time together beyond the screen. Join regular team gatherings and off-site retreats to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • Performance reviews. Every six months, we look back at your progress, recognise your wins, and agree on clear goals for what's next.
  • Equipment support. From day one, you get everything you need to do your best work, including a home office allowance if you work remotely.

Where we hire

Our Paris HQ is a lively hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection. From lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, it's a space people genuinely enjoy, in our brand-new office in the heart of Paris (awesome energy and snacks included).

We also have great teammates across Europe, from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you work from home in Barcelona or Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we mainly hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there, or planning to be, we'd love to hear from you!

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.

  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.

jobs.title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't.

Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist.

We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'.

What you'll work on

A wide range of work, across several brands at once:

  • Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing.

  • Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page.

  • Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them.

  • The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's.

By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them.

Ownership, for real

You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters.

That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane.

About AI

Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them.

We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt.

If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it.

Who you are

You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts.

You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers.

You'll need:

  • Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it.

  • Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool.

  • A real eye for typography, layout and motion.

  • Good English, written and spoken.

  • To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office.

Bonus points:

  • You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here.

  • You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist.

  • German.

A design role, not a development role

To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design. You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately.

If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is.

What you get

  • Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week.

  • Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs.

  • A portfolio that's actually live. Websites real people use, not concepts in a Figma file.

  • Founder-level access. You work directly with Eli, and you see how a studio launches products.

  • Work from anywhere in Germany. Remote is fine. If you're in Berlin, or want to be, there's a desk for you at our office.

  • A way in. If it's a great fit, the conversation towards the end of your internship is about staying on.

How we work

  • Execution beats perfection. We ship, learn and improve. We don't wait for perfect.

  • Be a sponge. Learn from everyone, every project and every mistake.

  • Agency is a skill. Nobody hands you the next step. You find it.

  • Say it directly. We tell you what we think, and we expect the same back.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with Eli Cloud Läufer, who founded Cloud Studios in Berlin in autumn 2025, and alongside Öykü, our product designer, and Jenna in marketing and design.

Who can apply

You must live in Germany and be currently enrolled at a German university or in vocational training in Germany, and one of these must apply to you:

  1. Mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum): your study or training regulations require you to complete an internship. You'll need to confirm this with your enrollment certificate and your program's internship requirement.

  2. Voluntary internship alongside your studies: up to three months, and only if you have never interned at Cloud Studios before.

If neither applies to you, we unfortunately can't consider your application.

Details

  • Duration: Three to six months (mandatory internship) or up to three months (voluntary internship).

  • Working hours: 20 to 40 hours per week.

  • Location: Remote from anywhere in Germany, or from our Berlin office. You don't need to be in Berlin.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Apply through our application form. It takes about ten minutes. The most important part is your portfolio, and the one project in it you'd fight for.

Show us something nobody else would have made.
